a.lede: Intel's next-gen Nova Lake desktop processors will be the first client product to use Intel's enhanced 18A-P node, CEO Lip-Bu Tan confirmed in the company's Q3 2026 earnings call.
a.title: Intel confirms Nova Lake will use advanced 18A-P node, more details at CES — company says it's taking Panther Lake capacity offline to build more Granite Rapids data center CPUs

b.lede: An internal driver and a shipping manifest reveal that Intel's desktop Raptor Lake Next parts may be on the way right now.
b.title: Intel quietly confirms Raptor Lake Next CPUs through internal driver publication
